svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
ola/modules/ripple/ - Ripple and noise, probe only
When it is seen: ripple measurement without an electronic load (the power supply already has
What to draw: the power supply (or the board) under test with its output (+ and −) and the
output capacitor drawn. An oscilloscope probe with the tip on + and the ground spring on −,
both very close to the capacitor; the probe goes to CH1 of the oscilloscope.
Details: the ground spring must be visible, next to the tip (it is the most important detail of
this measurement: a long ground lead shows false peaks). Better an enlargement (a circle with
zoom) on the probe point on the capacitor. Add the words 20 MHz (bandwidth limit) near the
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
